disclaimers_required: BossBoard does not provide legal or regulatory advice. The product helps operators generate, store, and share compliance records — but every regulatory obligation, every assessment, and every site decision remains the responsibility of the operator (or the relevant PCBU under HSWA 2015).

AI-generated content (SWMS hazards/controls and risk assessment suggestions) is template-style starting material. It is not a substitute for trained Health and Safety advice, a legal review, or on-site verification by a competent person.
BossBoard is invoicing and business management, not accounting. It does not file GST returns, does not replace your accountant, and integrates WITH Xero (planned) rather than replacing it.
